item.title: WiCi Infer Runs 800B-Parameter AI Models on a Laptop by Streaming Them From the SSD
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: original reporting, evidence and concrete detail

WiCi Infer, a free app, runs large LLMs on PCs with limited memory by streaming models from SSD. It uses InferSSD, an open-source engine, to store model weights on SSD and load only active parts into memory. This allows 800B-parameter models to run on laptops with 16-48GB RAM. Benchmarks show InferSSD is faster than standard llama.cpp. The trade-off is slower generation compared to cloud services, but it offers privacy and no software cost.

Source: HackerNoon | Published: 2026-11-20 16:00 UTC | Difficulty: 61/100

item.title: Uber Cuts Translation Cache Memory by up to 90% While Keeping P99 Latency Below 1 MS
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-condensed version. This text was produced by an LLM from the original article and may omit details. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: original reporting, evidence and concrete detail

Uber optimized its Go-based translation cache, reducing memory footprint by over 90% and maintaining p99 latency below 1 ms. The hybrid architecture stores keys in memory and values on disk, serving millions of translations/s with a 99.9% cache hit rate. Optimization replaced sync.Map with a conventional map, reducing object allocations and improving CPU utilization. Hybrid storage design with 256 shards and LRU policy reduced memory usage from 2.7 GB to 750 MB.

Source: InfoQ | Published: 2026-11-20 14:38 UTC | Difficulty: 61/100
